ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Oct-09-2008 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: Frank J. Drago, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Christina Council was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, DeMario Holmes.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minor to: Terrieak Sunnie Council.

Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-19-2008 Reset To Oct-09-08 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Christian Council was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the minor, DeMario Holmes.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file.

There is no proof of service re: notice to the minor's father of the proposed name change. Good cause appearing, the Order to Show Cause for Change of Name of a Minor is continued to October 19, 2008 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.

Petitioner shall submit to the Court a proof of service indicating that the minor's fathers was noticed of the new hearing date, or proof that petitioner was unable to locate the minor's father.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar May-06-2008 Reset To Jun-26-08 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of a Minor.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Petitioner Christina Council was present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minor Demario Ramon Holmes, who was not present at today's hearing.
Petitioner was placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in file, but petitioner did not provide the Court with proof of service that minor's father was notified of today's proceedings.

Good cause appearing, the Order to Show Cause for Change of Name of the minor, Demario Ramon Holmes, is continued to June 26, 2008 at 9:00 a.m. in Dept. 218.

Petitioner shall to submit proof of service to the minor's father of the new hearing date, or Order dispensing with notice.

Reissued Order to Show Cause for Change of Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
